item.title: DNA and underwater footage reveal two new species of deep-sea siphonophores
item.description: New research is shedding light on the diversity of deep-sea siphonophores. A team of scientists from MBARI, the University of Gdańsk, New York University and Yale University conducted a comprehensive examination of Bargmannia siphonophores using museum material, submersible observations and genomic sequencing. This work uncovered two previously unknown species: Bargmannia marlena and Bargmannia pyrosa. The team published their findings in the Zoological Journal of the Linnean Society last week. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: The assumption about farm automation that may be wrong
item.description: You've likely heard this assumption: When AI-enabled and autonomous machines arrive on the farm, jobs will disappear. But researchers at the University of California, Davis, who studied 16 fruit tree operations in California and Washington for three years, found that automation still takes human knowledge. What changes is how the work gets done. The study, drawing on 165 in-depth interviews with workers and growers, was published in the journal New Technology, Work and Employment. Fuente: Phys.org.

El temblor ha tenido una profundidad superficial de 10 kilómetros.La Administración Sismológica de China ha activado una respuesta de emergencia de nivel II , según ha informado la agencia… Publicado también por: El País - Internacional, La Nación - El Mundo, El Mundo - Internacional. Fuente: ABC España - Internacional.
